name: firstcontact
title: firstcontact
blurb: Enter a handle and it downloads your whole atproto repo as one CAR, walks every collection in it — likes, replies, quote posts, reposts, follows, mentions, even records from apps it's never seen before — and builds a chronological table of every account you ever made contact with, one row per account, timestamped at the moment it first happened. Asked for by @psingletary.com.
